*addresses*

## [`sfx_sample_table`](../../src/sfx/sfx_samples_f540.asm#L6) `$F540-$F54F`

*words*

Sample table: entries of (start, end) offsets from $f540. sfx_sample_start ($3186) adds $f540 and plays the bytes from start to end, both included. Only entries 0-3 hold samples. The range $f540-$ff3f is the floor, bitmap rows 17-24. All four floor colours are 7 ($192f, NMI $2ff2), so the sample bytes do not show.
Entry 0: $f580-$f663, for hit reaction $16, the knockdown ($2ce7).

- **Read by:** [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$3198`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L91), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$319B`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L92), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$319F`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L94), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31A2`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L95), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31A7`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L98), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31AA`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L99), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31AE`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L101), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](modules/sfx/sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31B1`](../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L102)
